baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition in فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ and the knowledge clause that follows it.
baseline_models.mechanism: Their emitted speech is an external pressure capable of roughening the inner self with grief; the prohibition blocks that transfer because both the concealed and the manifest already lie within divine knowing.

activation_trace.role: Inner roughness through grief supplies the affected surface that the prohibition refuses to let their speech produce.
Speech brought out in utterance supplies the external input whose passage into grief is blocked.
The thing's disclosure to a knower grounds the relocation of the matter from the addressee's affect to divine apprehension.
Concealment in the interior establishes the hidden pole of the knowledge claim.
Manifest appearance and public declaration establish the exposed pole of the knowledge claim.

changed_reading.before: Do not feel sad because of the hostile words they say.
changed_reading.after: Do not let their public utterance become an inner roughness; the hidden-to-manifest field in which that speech operates is already held within divine knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْلُهُمْ read beside مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The qawl inventory ranges from circulated utterance to unspoken inner saying and settled belief. The singular verbal anchor can therefore name a whole speech-position whose private formation and public circulation are both known.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulating among people supplies the social and repeatable surface of their qawl.
A saying held in the self before expression supplies the private precursor to public speech.
Qawl as conviction supplies the durable position beneath a momentary utterance.
Interior concealment receives the unspoken and convictional layers of qawl.
Public manifestation receives the circulated and spoken layers of qawl.

changed_reading.before: Their saying denotes the words presently uttered.
changed_reading.after: Their saying denotes a speech-system extending from inward conviction and unspoken formulation to public, circulating claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier writing, residual-trace, exhaustive-counting, and manifestation sequence turns the knowledge clause into more than immediate awareness. What is concealed or announced enters a preserved evidentiary field that includes consequences left behind.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing lets knowing be sharpened as knowledge through resolvable evidence.
The concealed supplies material that might appear to evade an evidentiary record.
The manifest supplies the publicly inspectable half of the same evidentiary field.
Entering a name into a register supplies durable inscription rather than transient awareness.
A remaining mark that indicates what occurred extends the known object from acts and words to their after-effects.
Counting with exhaustive coverage supplies the record's completeness.
Manifest disclosure supplies the register's eventual legibility even for what began concealed.

structural_cues: 36:12 couples writing what was sent ahead with preserving effects left behind.
The same ayah then exhaustively counts everything in a manifest register.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, residual marks, exhaustive counting, and manifestation; I infer that knowing in 36:76 includes preservation and accountability, while a live alternative keeps 36:12 as a separate resurrection ledger.

changed_reading.before: God is aware of both private and public speech.
changed_reading.after: No suppressed or public position is ephemeral: it belongs to a preserved and enumerable trail that also retains what the speakers set in motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The city-messenger sequence joins divine knowing to a sharply bounded task of clear delivery. The focus prohibition can therefore release the addressee from treating hostile reception as a failure he must absorb.

activation_trace.role: Inner roughness through grief is the burden from which the speaker is released.
Knowing as apprehension supplies the witness invoked when the messengers' status is contested.
Causing the message to reach its recipient supplies the bounded human task.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign specifies the quality required of that delivery.

structural_cues: 36:16 answers contested sentness by invoking the Lord's knowing.
36:17 limits the messengers' obligation to clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divine witness and a delivery boundary; I infer continuity between that messenger posture and the addressee of 36:76, while the live alternative treats the city episode only as an analogy rather than a direct role instruction.

changed_reading.before: The line offers emotional reassurance after hurtful speech.
changed_reading.after: The line also enforces a task boundary: make the message reach clearly, but do not internalize the hearers' response as part of the messenger's obligation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah itself voices lament over servants who repeatedly mock messengers, yet the focus addressee is told not to be roughened by their speech. The prohibition is thus affective containment, not a denial that the pattern is lamentable.

activation_trace.role: Grief as inner roughness marks the personal affective capture being prohibited.
Lament over what is missed preserves the evaluative sorrow of the wider pattern.
Mockery supplies the recurrent speech-behavior that warrants lament without governing the addressee's interior.

structural_cues: 36:30 places lament and repeated messenger-mockery in one construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surah-level lament and addressee-level no-grief; I infer a redistribution of affect rather than emotional numbness, while the live alternative reads both expressions simply as independent rhetorical intensities.

changed_reading.before: Do not be sad, as though sadness itself were an incorrect evaluation.
changed_reading.after: The pattern remains lamentable, but its lament need not be installed as the messenger's private injury.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contains another qawl whose source is sovereign and merciful and whose content is safety. Their circulating qawl is therefore not the only speech act in the field and need not receive final affective authority.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulated among people supplies the hostile social speech whose authority is being relativized.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the effect and content of the counter-speech.
Speech brought forth in utterance identifies peace as a second qawl rather than a silent state.
Sovereignty supplies the source hierarchy between the two sayings.
Merciful tenderness specifies why the higher speech act restores rather than roughens the interior.

structural_cues: 36:58 explicitly constructs peace as a qawl from a merciful Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two qawl occurrences with radically different sources and effects; I infer a hierarchy of speech acts, while the live alternative keeps the paradisal qawl temporally separate from the present consolation.

changed_reading.before: The addressee should ignore hostile words.
changed_reading.after: The addressee should refuse those words final affective authority because the surah also locates safety in a sovereign, merciful qawl.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sealing-and-testimony scene reverses normal disclosure: controlled mouths cease, while hands speak and feet disclose acquired acts. Their chosen qawl is only one provisional surface; divine knowing reaches an involuntary evidentiary layer.

activation_trace.role: Interior concealment supplies what speakers attempt to keep outside testimony.
Manifest declaration supplies the controlled public layer that the bodily scene overturns.
A securing seal supplies the removal of ordinary mouth-controlled testimony.
The mouth opened for speech identifies the familiar disclosure channel that is disabled.
Intelligible speech connecting interlocutors transfers disclosure from mouth to hand.
Statement grounded in knowledge makes the feet an evidentiary witness rather than a rhetorical speaker.
The earning limbs image binds acquired conduct to the bodily instruments that disclose it.

structural_cues: 36:65 seals the ordinary speaking organ and redistributes speech and witness across hands and feet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disabled voluntary speech and involuntary bodily evidence; I infer that 36:76 relativizes the speakers' managed public account, while the live alternative treats 36:65 solely as a future scene rather than the mechanism of present consolation.

changed_reading.before: God knows what hostile speakers say publicly and keep private.
changed_reading.after: Their managed verbal presentation is not the final evidentiary layer: concealed conduct can be disclosed through the very body that acquired it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, hoped-for help collapses into inability and an assembled supporting cohort. Their qawl can thus be heard as the public rhetoric of a failed protection arrangement whose private dependence and public defense are both transparent.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulating among people lets their qawl function as coalition-maintaining public discourse.
Concealed interiority supplies the unannounced dependence or calculation beneath that public front.
Public manifestation supplies the coalition's announced defense.
Help that supports and makes visible supplies the hoped-for function of the adopted protectors.
The same helping function is explicitly negated, exposing the arrangement's failure.
A mutually supporting host supplies the social mass that can sustain a claim despite failed protection.
Presence, witnessing, and nearness supply the image of that host mustered into view.

structural_cues: 36:74-75 move from hoped-for help to inability and a mustered host.
36:76 begins with a consequential فَلَا immediately after that reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and a failed help-host relation; I infer that public speech helps maintain that support structure, while the direction of the pronoun relation in 36:75 and a broader referent for their qawl remain live alternatives.

changed_reading.before: Their saying is an isolated hurtful remark.
changed_reading.after: Their saying may be coalition speech that publicly maintains dependence on powerless protectors; divine knowledge sees both the private need and the announced front.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence stages a visible disputant whose spoken challenge is preceded by forgetting his own creation. It gives the hidden/manifest pair a causal reading: an inwardly unavailable or suppressed premise generates outward argumentative qawl.

activation_trace.role: Interior concealment supplies the cognitive layer upstream of the spoken dispute.
Public manifestation supplies the explicit argumentative challenge.
Contention between opponents supplies the social form taken by the outward speech.
Loss of a remembered premise supplies the interior operation preceding the challenge.
Emitted speech turns the missing premise into an overt question about reviving bones.

structural_cues: 36:78 orders forgetting before the disputant's quoted question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forgetting followed by explicit dispute; I infer an upstream-to-downstream relation between interior omission and public claim, while the live alternative treats forgetting as non-deliberate and therefore not equivalent to intentional concealment.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge covers two separate classes, secret statements and public statements.
changed_reading.after: Divine knowledge also diagnoses the route between them: an inwardly dropped premise can generate the outward qawl that appears as confident dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing command sequence binds will, authoritative command, saying, and coming-to-be. Human qawl can dispute and wound affectively, but divine qawl is presented as performative actuality; the power asymmetry recalibrates how much weight their speech should receive.

activation_trace.role: Their emitted speech supplies the rhetorically forceful but non-creative speech act.
Binding request and command supply the authoritative mode of the closing speech act.
Will and volition supply the initiating condition for the command.
Speech brought forth supplies the verbal hinge between willing and actuality.
A thing's occurring and presence in time supplies the realized effect of that saying.

structural_cues: 36:82 sequences willing, saying, and coming-to-be without an intervening persuasive contest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct will-to-saying-to-occurrence sequence; I infer a contrast in speech-act power with their qawl in 36:76, while the live alternative denies that the closing creation formula is meant to qualify the earlier consolation.

changed_reading.before: Their words feel powerful because they can injure and contest the message.
changed_reading.after: Their qawl has rhetorical and affective force but not ontological force; the surah closes with a saying whose effect is the occurrence of what is willed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ح ز ز mapping and the wound branch of a context verb whose surface sense is speaking. It remains anchored to يَحْزُنكَ, قَوْلُهُمْ, and the later bodily speech scene. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-branch word-image, never as the lexical translation of either verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The transition from قَوْلُهُمْ to يَحْزُنكَ.

activation_trace.role: Emitted speech supplies the incoming verbal force.
Cutting that leaves a trace recasts grief as the mark speech threatens to incise.
The bodily wound branch of speaking supplies the cross-domain bridge between word and incision.

changed_reading.before: Their speech causes an emotion called sadness.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the prohibition stops their utterance from becoming an incision that leaves its trace in the receiver's interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a material transformation in 36:80 is mapped onto the human concealment-disclosure pair of 36:76. It remains anchored to يُسِرُّونَ and يُعْلِنُونَ through the packet's green-tree, fire, and kindling sequence. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for latent disclosure, not a lexical gloss or a claim that the ayah's direct object is fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The polarity between مَا يُسِرُّونَ and مَا يُعْلِنُونَ.

activation_trace.role: Interior concealment supplies the latent pole of the analogy.
Manifest appearance supplies the disclosed pole of the analogy.
The stemmed tree supplies the material carrier whose visible state does not exhaust its capacity.
Fresh green plant matter supplies the outwardly unlikely container of ignition.
Kindled fire supplies the formerly latent capacity brought into manifestation.
Ignition supplies the transition by which concealed capacity becomes an active public effect.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge observes whatever people keep private or state openly.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine knowledge also comprehends latent emergence: as fire can be disclosed from green material, a concealed human interior cannot define the limits of what may be brought out.

strongest_changes: Divine knowledge shifted from bare awareness to a preserved evidentiary system of records, residual traces, and bodily testimony.
Repeated qawl became a hierarchy of speech acts: circulating hostile discourse, peace-giving speech, and the command whose saying becomes actuality.
The post-focus disputant exposed a causal route from inward forgetting to outward argument.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet turned a brief affective reassurance into a role boundary and an evidence mechanism, then placed hostile speech between a merciful counter-speech and creative command. The immediate failed-support sequence also made a social, coalition-level reading of their qawl possible.
remaining_uncertainties: Their qawl may denote a particular utterance, a recurring hostile repertoire, or a broader convictional and social position.
The pronoun direction in the help-and-host relation of 36:74-75 remains live, so the coalition reading should stay medium-confidence.
The incision and latent-ignition outliers are branch-guided analogies and must not be rendered as direct lexical meanings.
